Overall, Number Puzzle is a game that is perfect for those who love puzzle games and are looking for a challenge. With its addictive gameplay, impressive visuals, and simple controls, this game is a must-play for anyone who enjoys solving puzzles and strategic games.

To progress through the levels, you'll need to think strategically and use the right numbers to clear the puzzle. The game also introduces a time limit for each level, which adds an extra level of pressure to the game. Overall, the core gameplay mechanics of Number Puzzle are simple yet addictive, making it a must-play for fans of puzzle games.
